events.verdict: Antetokounmpo (MIL) steps into White's (CHI) path late and does not give him a step to avoid the contact during the dribble handoff.
Vucevic (CHI) legally sets the pick on Porter Jr. (MIL) and the pairs' arms briefly become incidentally entangled as Vucevic releases away to roll to the basket.
Green (MIL) establishes a screening position outside of Collins' (CHI) field of view and gives him a step to avoid the contact.
Giddey (CHI) swipes down and initiates illegal contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm, which affects his post shot attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) steps over late and initiates illegal leg to leg contact that impedes Kuzma's (MIL) ability to navigate the pick.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) directly contests Smith's (CHI) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Smith's hand after the release.
Turner (MIL) establishes himself in Smith's (CHI) path prior to the marginal contact that occurs during the pick.

Vucevic (CHI) is moving alongside Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path and rests his forearm on his side as he defends the driving shot attempt. This contact is marginal and does not rise to the level of a foul.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) fails to inbound the ball in under 5 seconds.
Okoro (CHI) briefly engages and disengages with Green (MIL) while defending the inbound.
Porter Jr. (MIL) directly contests White's (CHI) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to White's hand after the release.
Huerter (CHI) commits a take foul on Rollins (MIL).
White (CHI) commits a take foul on Antetokounmpo (MIL). This foul occurs prior to Antetokounmpo's upward shooting motion.
After the rebound, White (CHI) grazes Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm at the start of the drive. This contact does not rise to the level of a foul.
